prompts.prompt: We're a 40-person UK software company bidding for a central government contract that requires Cyber Essentials. We've never done it. What's involved and what will it cost?

How fast do we actually have to patch things for Cyber Essentials, and what about our old Windows Server 2012 box?
We passed basic Cyber Essentials last month. What happens in the Plus audit and what trips people up?
Does Cyber Essentials really come with free insurance? And our customer is an MoD prime — what will they expect from us?
